label: Friendly fire
description: Projectiles, AoE, explosions and traps also hurt allies.

label: Difficulty
description: Multiplies monster health and damage: Medium +50% health and +25% damage, Hard +150% health and +60% damage.

label: Torches
description: On: take torches from the walls to light the dark. Off: every hero carries a steady light of their own.

label: Shared vision
description: Enemies seen by any teammate are visible to everyone.
